kills.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint) so anyone can call it and drain funds.

kills.property: Only the true owner can successfully execute sendMoney; the bugged modifier allows any caller to pass the guard, resulti
kills.change_summary: Delete the require check inside onlyOwner so the modifier never reverts, letting anyone pass the guard.

kills.property: For any caller sending money via sendMoney, the owner can subsequently withdraw the contract balance, but the buggy modi
kills.change_summary: Change onlyOwner to check msg.sender != owner, reversing the access control so owner is locked out and anyone else can call protected functions.

kills.property: Any non-owner caller cannot successfully transfer Ether via sendMoney, because only the owner has the required permission; the buggy version allows any caller to send money.
kills.change_summary: Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, making it allow any caller.

kills.property: For any caller and any prior state, calling withdrawAll() from the owner must leave the contract balance unchanged only if the call reverted; the buggy version always leaves the balance unchanged without reverting, so the balance after a non-reverting owner call is not zero.
kills.change_summary: Delete the withdraw call inside withdrawAll, so the function does nothing and balance remains unchanged.

kills.property: For any call to sendMoney(_target, _value) by owner, the reference contract transfers _value wei to _target, while the mutant transfers zero wei; thus the target's balance after the call is unchanged only in the buggy version.
kills.change_summary: Replace _target.call{value: _value}("") with an empty statement so no call is made and the ether transfer does not happen.

kills.property: After a call to sendMoney, the recipient's balance must increase by exactly the _value argument; the mutant sends 0 instead.
kills.change_summary: Replace _target.call{value: _value}("") with _target.call{value: 0}("") so the sent value always differs from the caller's intended _value.
